svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Maximum aggregate area of unprotected openings in an exposing building
face
(a) Table 9.10.14.4.-A, (b) Subsection 3.2.3., or (c) where the limiting
distance is 1.2 m (3′-11¼″) or more, not more than the limiting distance squared
for residential, business and personal services and low-hazard industrial
occupancies, and half the limiting distance squared for mercantile and
medium-hazard industrial. Except as in Sentences (6) to (10).
Below 1.2 m, openings are protected by closures, other than wired glass
or glass block
Rated as Table 9.10.13.1. requires for the rating of the wall.
At 2 m (6′-6¾″) or less, each unprotected opening is within Table
9.10.14.4.-B or, from 1.2 m, the formula
Not for sprinklered buildings, or for openable windows with a 0.35 m² (3.8 ft²)
unobstructed opening installed per Sentences 9.9.10.1.(1) and (2).
Such openings serving a single room or space are at least 2 m apart
Horizontally on the same face, or vertically from an opening serving that room
or space or another on the same storey. A single room or space (5) includes
adjacent spaces whose full-height dividing wall extends less than 1.5 m (4′-11″)
from the interior face of the exterior wall, and stacked spaces on the same
storey.
Twice the Sentence (1) area is permitted
(6) with wired glass in steel frames (9.10.13.5.) or glass blocks (9.10.13.7.),
or (7) in a sprinklered building where all rooms adjacent to the face with
unprotected openings, including closets and bathrooms, are sprinklered,
notwithstanding exemptions in the standards referenced in Article 3.2.5.12.
Sentence (1) need not apply to
(8) a storage garage with all storeys open-air and a limiting distance of at
least 3 m (9′-10⅛″), or (9) a storey facing a street at street level, with a
limiting distance of at least 9 m (29′-6⅜″).
Detached garages or accessory buildings serving one dwelling unit only
(10) Glazed openings are limited as unprotected openings, but (11) not on a face
toward the dwelling unit it serves, on the same property, where that dwelling
unit is the only major occupancy there.
Drawn: a 2 storey residential building 1.5 m from the property line. Red: the exposing building face.
